summary: Lemhi County, Idaho lookout in the Salmon NF: two-story log cabin by 1935, destroyed 1965 per two sources but likely burned in the 1950s per a 1982 history; site today undescribed.

facts.status_note: Firelookout.com and Forest Lookouts date destruction to 1965; a 1982 history quoted in a climbing guide says it was likely burned in the 1950s; no current description found

visit.trail_note: Climbing guide: take the Bighorn Crags Road/FS-114 to FS-167-2, then a precipitous 4WD road to the summit; check Forest Service road conditions

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com and Forest Lookouts date destruction to 1965, citing Kresek. A 1982 history quoted by the climbing guide says it was likely burned in the 1950s. Both are stated in the story; the events list uses 1965 only.
Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 9,096 feet; the climbing guide gives 9,083 feet. The story gives both.

notes_for_editor: Brief status gone and coordinates 45.11868, -114.41677 agree with the climbing guide (45.11859, -114.41639), so no correction. The 1924 14x14 house and the 1935 two-story cabin are both reported; the sources do not say whether they are the same structure, so the story does not claim it. The 1950s burn is a decade only and is not an event with a year. Weebly's single 'Removed' label has no date or explanation. Access: the climbing guide describes a 4WD road but no source states public status, so access is omitted. No source describes the summit today. No photo was found.
